question:
(i) Define electric flux through a surface and obtain its expression for a uniform electric field passing through a plane surface.
(ii) A plane surface of area $0.04\,\text{m}^2$ is placed in a uniform electric field of $300\,\text{N}\,\text{C}^{-1}$ such that the angle between the field and area vector is $60^\circ$. Calculate the electric flux through the surface.

options.C:
(i) Electric flux is $\Phi=\vec E\cdot\vec S=ES\cos\theta$ for a uniform field through a plane surface
(ii) $\Phi=6\,\text{N m}^2\text{C}^{-1}$
options.D:
(i) Electric flux is independent of the area vector
(ii) $\Phi=0$
